summary: Excel add-in 3.0.1 loads missing values after formula entry and fixes slow workbook refresh discovery.
details: Typing, editing, or pasting an ArcRho formula loads missing results without requiring a Refresh button, including formulas with an explicit project name.
Opening saved workbooks and ordinary recalculation continue to use saved values without contacting the server.
Refresh Workbook scans large array formulas once and shows progress while finding formulas.
